s1.desc: an igloo room with pale ice-brick walls

spans.notes: Pax and Polly stand at the front door with their suitcases; Pax waves and hurries off to the right with his green suitcase, Polly stays. lead_copy: Pax's green suitcase carries a charm of a pink penguin with a crest, white face, blush and headphones (full res f0: Polly's look), in view until he leaves with it (~f44); Polly's yellow suitcase carries a black-and-white penguin charm in a red jacket (not a lead). Camera also drifts (ECC on the door band tx -24 px by f4, -48 px from f32, cc 0.90-0.99). The clean tail f44-49 is 6 frames, so not split

Pax kneels behind his open green suitcase stuffing in clothes from a laundry basket, then hops up and runs out to the right (~f110-118); suitcase and basket alone to f124. The pink Polly-look charm hangs on the front of the open suitcase in every frame (full res f60)

spans.view: with a round window looking out on a snowy garden and the edge of a door

beats.text: Polly stands by the round window with one flipper on the handle of her yellow suitcase, glancing to the side
Polly lowers her flipper and keeps glancing sideways, waiting beside her suitcase
Polly narrows her eyes into an impatient frown
Polly glances around with heavy-lidded eyes, still waiting beside her suitcase

spans.notes: camera locked f125-179: ECC on the door band (y 0.25-0.65, x 0.85-1.0) scale 1.0000, <= 0.2 px, cc 1.000 every 3rd frame, and on the window+door band per frame f175-179; compare 125/179 window, door and suitcase edges black. The view in the window (tree, flowering bush, igloo, snow) does not change before f180 (window-region pixel diff vs f125 <= 0.1 to f179); the season time-lapse only starts at f218. The suitcase charm is a black-and-white penguin in a red puffer jacket with bunny ears, neither lead. No overlay (pixel scan every 6th frame)

spans.view: with a round window looking out on a snowy garden and the edge of a door

beats.text: Polly stands beside her yellow suitcase and turns her gaze to the left
Polly waddles off to the left out of the picture, leaving her suitcase standing alone by the window

spans.notes: steady push-in from f180: ECC on the window+door band (y 0.30-0.55, x 0.38-1.0, cc >= 0.98) scale 1.002 at f180, 1.012 at f185, 1.024 at f191, 1.043 at f203, 1.064 at f209 (door band locked to f179). Polly is half out of the picture from ~f204 and only a thin sliver of her back shows f214-219 (gone at f220), so exits_at 214. Ends at f218, the first frame of the time-lapse cross-dissolve on the suitcase. Only reason: camera_move

the suitcase alone by the window while a time-lapse runs: cross-dissolves pile a coat, a scarf and hat, a tablecloth, slippers, flowers and a picture frame on it while the window tree goes autumn, bare and green again (effect as well). Polly's last sliver at the left edge f218-219. The framed picture on the table at the end shows a penguin face (would be lead_copy too)
